{{Quote|So, would you say we ''saved'' the ''moon'', Master?''"<br />"''I just ''might'', Snips.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Inside Job" />}}
'''A battle''' was fought around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Separatists invaded the moon in [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] protected by an experimental [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] technology, which prevented the Confederate vessels from taking any damage from Gall defenders' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. However, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were on the moon at the time of the attack, managed to infiltrate the [[Shielded Separatist craft|lead craft]] that was projecting the shield and destroyed it with explosive charges from within, leaving the planetary defenses to destroy the rest of the invasion force.

==The battle==
{{Quote|It's ''impossible!''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''What is, Sergeant?''"<br />"''Our ''blasters'' can't penetrate their ''shield'', but the droids are having ''no'' trouble blasting ''us'' to shreds ''through'' it!|[[Unidentified Gall sergeant|A Gall sergeant]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Inside Job" />}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attacked the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] with a force of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], 2 [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and a [[Shielded Separatist craft|lead landing craft]], which was equipped with an experimental [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] origin. The shield extended itself onto the entire Confederate force and allowed the Separatist forces to shoot through it while at the same time protecting them from enemy fire. Gall planetary force under the command of a [[Unidentified Gall sergeant|sergeant]] engaged the enemy, attacking with [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] and [[Gall starfighter|starfighters]], but were not able to penetrate the shield.<ref name="Inside Job" />

At the time of the attack, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were stationed on the moon. After being informed by the sergeant of the shield's capabilities, Skywalker came up with a plan to lower it. Taking a pack of explosive charges, Skywalker and his Padawan piloted two [[jet-wing]]s, which were normally used for spraying fertilizers, and used them to reach the lead landing craft. The jet-wings were not detected by the ship's sensors, and the two Jedi were able to land on its hull. They managed to infiltrate the craft, although the jet-wings were destroyed by enemy fire in the process. Inside, they found stacks of deactivated [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but Skywalker considered them not to be a threat, since he believed that all energy had been diverted to the shield. Skywalker and Tano reached the controls of the shield and started planting explosives.<ref name="Inside Job" />

[[File:SkywalkerAndTanoOnGall-TCWUK61.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Tano fight off battle droid attacks.]]
Once the explosives were set and the five-minute countdown began, an intruder alert was sounded and the Jedi were attacked by a large number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA series super battle droids]]. Hoping to escape from the vessel, Skywalker and Tano tried to reach the airlock, but were overwhelmed by droids. As the countdown to the explosion continued, they took a defensive stance and fought for their lives against the Separatist forces, until Skywalker concentrated on coming up with an escape plan and remembered the behavior of [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] from his native planet of Tatooine; when in danger, the womp rats burrowed into the sand.<ref name="Inside Job" />

Following the womp rats' example, Skywalker used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut a hole in the ship's floor, and he jumped into the hole with Tano right before the landing craft exploded. The Jedi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to slow their descent and landed on top of their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]], which had just been refueled and piloted there by Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. With the lead landing craft destroyed, the shield was gone, and Skywalker was assured that the planetary defense force would be able to repel the rest of the invasion force.<ref name="Inside Job" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was featured in ''[[Inside Job]]'', a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] published the UK-exclusive magazine ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.1]]'' in [[December]] of [[2009]].
